teaser.en: When its new leaves unfold, the woodland blushes pink and scarlet before turning green.
teaser.sw: Majani yake mapya yanapochipuka, pori hugeuka rangi ya waridi na nyekundu iliyokolea kabla ya kuwa kijani.
teaser.dg: Makodzage maphya ganaphotuluka, mihi yosi phara inakala ya rangi ya pinki na ya kundu kabla ya kukala ya chijani.

summary.en: *Mrihi*, the msasa, is the flat-crowned tree that defines *Brachystegia* woodland on the sandy soils of the coastal plain. Pakia lists it among the popular Digo timber species, used for door frames, furniture and canoes.
summary.sw: *Mrihi*, au *myombo*, ni mti wenye kilele bapa unaotambulisha mapori ya *Brachystegia* kwenye udongo wa kichanga wa uwanda wa pwani. Pakia inauorodhesha miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Kidigo, zinazotumika kwa fremu za milango, samani na mitumbwi.
summary.dg: *Mrihi* (kpwa Chingereza *msasa*) ni muhi wenye dari sawa-sawa inayotandazika, ambao ndio muhi mkulu wa herera zenye mihi ya *Brachystegia*, kpwa tsi ya mtsanga ya herera ya pwani. Pakia anauolanga kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo, inayohumirwa kuhenda miimo ya miryango, vyombo vya nyumba na ngarawa.

about.en:
*Mrihi* is a deciduous tree from 8 to 25 metres tall, with a flat, spreading crown. Its leaves are glossy and dark, with three to five pairs of leaflets.

Its most famous moment is when it comes back into leaf. The new flush is strikingly pink to scarlet, so a stand of *mrihi* can look as if it is in autumn colour, before the leaves turn green.
about.sw:
*Mrihi* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye urefu wa mita 8 hadi 25, na kilele bapa kilichotanda. Majani yake yanang'aa na yana rangi iliyokolea, yakiwa na jozi tatu hadi tano za vijani.

Wakati wake maarufu zaidi ni unapochipua majani upya. Machipukizi mapya yana rangi ya waridi hadi nyekundu iliyokolea inayovutia sana, hivyo kundi la *mrihi* linaweza kuonekana kana kwamba liko katika rangi za majira ya kupukutika, kabla majani hayajageuka kijani.
about.dg:
*Mrihi* ni muhi ambao makodzage ganagbwa kpwa muda, wa mita nane hadi ishirini na tsano kpwa ure, wenye dari sawa-sawa inayotandazika. Makodzage ganang'ala na ni ga chijani sana, na chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano kpwa chila uphande.

Wakati unaomanyikana zaidi ni uchilavya makodza maphya. Makodza higo maphya ni ga pinki hadi kundu sana, kpwa hivyo kundi ra *mrihi* rinaweza kuonekana dza mihi wakati wa *autumn*, kabla makodza kukala ga chijani.

where.en: *Mrihi* grows in *Brachystegia* woodland on the sandy soils of the coastal plain and the foot plateau. Where it grows it is often the main tree, giving the woodland its name. Look for the red flush when the trees put out new leaves.
where.sw: *Mrihi* huota katika mapori ya *Brachystegia* kwenye udongo wa kichanga wa uwanda wa pwani na uwanda wa chini wa miinuko. Mahali unapoota mara nyingi ndio mti mkuu, na huyapa mapori hayo jina lake. Tafuta rangi nyekundu ya machipukizi miti inapotoa majani mapya.
where.dg: *Mrihi* unamera kpwenye herera zenye mihi ya *Brachystegia*, kpwa tsi ya mtsanga ya herera ya pwani na ya photsi ya milima. Phatu unaphomera mara nyinji ndio muhi mkulu, na ndio unaozipha herera hizo dzina. Lola makodza ga kundu wakati mihi inalavya makodza maphya.

uses.en:
The timber is used for door frames, furniture and canoes, and Pakia lists *mrihi* among the popular Digo timber species. It also gives poles, firewood and charcoal.

The bark gives tannin, and the tree is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake hutumika kwa fremu za milango, samani na mitumbwi, na Pakia inaorodhesha *mrihi* miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Kidigo. Pia hutoa nguzo, kuni na mkaa.

Gome hutoa tanini, na mti huu hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.
uses.dg:
Mbao nkuhumirwa kuhenda miimo ya miryango, vyombo vya nyumba na ngarawa, na Pakia anaolanga *mrihi* kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo. Piya unalavya nguzo, kuni na makala.

Gopha rinalavya tanini, na muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *mrihi*. Pakia also uses *mrihi* for another tree, *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*. In Swahili it is *mrihi* or *myombo*, and in Giriama *mrihi* or *mjombo*. In English it is called msasa.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF vinatoa jina la Kidigo *mrihi*. Pakia pia inatumia *mrihi* kwa mti mwingine, *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mrihi* au *myombo*, na kwa Kigiriama *mrihi* au *mjombo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *msasa*.
names.dg: Pakia anapha dzina ra Chidigo *mrihi*, na chitabu cha ICRAF piya. Pakia piya anahumira *mrihi* kpwa muhi wanjina, *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mrihi* au *myombo*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mrihi* au *mjombo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *msasa*.
